results.title: Consul General Brandon Hudspeth to naval leaders from 30 nations and organizations: Don’t mistake progress for permanence.
results.description:
Consul General Brandon Hudspeth to naval leaders from 30 nations and organizations: Don’t mistake progress for permanence. Bad actors adapt, so the international response must too. 
 
Opening the 3rd Transatlantic Maritime Security Symposium in Lagos, he pointed to the Gulf of Guinea as proof of what coordinated national, regional, and global effort can achieve. The four-day event focused on strengthening the Yaoundé Code of Conduct and deepening joint patrols.  It was organized by the National Defense University’s Africa Center for Strategic Studies and the William J. Perry Center for Hemispheric Defense Studies.

results.title: #ThisWeekinUSNigeriaHistory in 1999, Secretary of State Madeleine K.
results.description:
#ThisWeekinUSNigeriaHistory in 1999, Secretary of State Madeleine K. Albright visited Nigeria and met with President Olusegun Obasanjo and other senior Nigerian officials at an important moment in United States-Nigeria relations.

The visit advanced practical cooperation on trade and investment, education, public health, and regional security. Today, the United States continues to engage Nigeria on shared priorities including expanding commercial opportunities, strengthening security cooperation, protecting religious freedom, and advancing regional peace and stability.

Photo credit: Gettyimages
